reason: As Frank, I find A slightly more persuasive. It says outright that a new restaurant would spend about $40,000 on a hood like the one already installed. It also gives me a clear June 1 deadline and a promise to sign within two weeks, so I know exactly what to do next. B nicely puts the auto-pay and signing promises right into the offer and acknowledges the coffee chain more gracefully. But it has no answer-by date and leaves out the $40,000 figure.
